title: Who Was William Henry Harrison? — The Whole Story #Shorts
description:
The first real success of William Henry Harrison arrived later than anyone expected, and changed everything. William Henry Harrison (February 9, 1773 – April 4, 1841) was the ninth president of the United States from March to April 1841. He died 31 days into his term, making him the shortest serving president and the first president to die in office.

Somebody like William Henry Harrison should not have made it — that is exactly why the story survives. In 1804, Harrison was assigned to administer the civilian government of the District of Louisiana. He conducted the district's affairs for five weeks until the Louisiana Territory was formally established on July 4, 1805, and Brigadier General James Wilkinson assumed the duties of governor.
